video.title: The State of Enterprise Operations Security: Our Interview with Rob Lee
video.description:
Rob Lee touches on the difference between enterprise IT Security and OT (operations technology) Security during our interview at RSA Conference 2020, yet underscores the importance of uniting the two -- not bifurcating the industry. Lee explains the far-reaching touchpoints of OT security and the potentially catastrophic situations that industrial security faces as a result of our increasingly connected world. He cautions that in light of all of this we shouldn't over-regulate to correct for this.

Rob Lee is a SANS Institute fellow and founder, and CEO at Dragos, Inc.

video.title: The Latest Cyber Attack Techniques to Watch for in 2020: Our Interview with Ed Skoudis
video.description:
Ed Skoudis sat down with us at RSA Conference 2020 to talk about deep persistence, attackers "living off the land", and the latest penetration techniques he's seeing. Skoudis also shares with us the two events he looks forward to most every year at RSA Conference, which includes the Cryptographer's Panel.

Ed Skoudis is a SANS Institute fellow and a world-renowned pen-testing expert.

video.title: Solving Cybersecurity's Talent Gap | RSAC 2020
video.description: The number of unfilled jobs in cybersecurity is expected to reach 4 million by 2022. As our industry faces a critical workforce shortage and talent gap, several experts at RSA Conference 2020 emphasized the need to create a culture of inclusion, as well as where we should be looking to find the cybersecurity experts of tomorrow.

video.title: The Future of Supply Chain Security | RSAC 2020
video.description: As organizations rapidly change supply chain tactics to meet the demands of evolving global ecosystems, security and risk mitigation need to be top of mind every step of the way. Experts at RSA Conference 2020 weigh in on the state of supply chain security and the vulnerabilities that need our focus.

video.title: Humans are Resilient and Adaptive: Our Interview with Bruce Schneier
video.description:
Humans are resilient, adaptive, and have a knack for figuring our way out of really bad problems. Bruce Schneier explains why these traits coupled with a security mindset gives us the special ability to make advancements not only to cyber security, but to society as a whole. He theorizes that security professionals have a unique perspective that could -- and should --  influence policy. 

Schneier also shares valuable tips for getting the most out of RSA Conference and all that it offers.

Bruce Schneier is an award-winning author, a world-renowned cryptographer and cybersecurity expert, and an RSA Conference veteran presenter.

video.title: Preview: Quantum computing's potential is limitless | RSAC 2020
video.description:
Steve Grobman, Senior Vice President and Chief Technology Officer, McAfee, discusses how quantum computing will one day solve some of society's biggest challenges such as a universal vaccine. But it is our current cloud architectures that allow scientists to fight disease and solve many of these challenges, today.

Watch the full keynote here: https://www.rsaconference.com/industry-topics/presentation/time-to-tell

video.title: Preview: Can we build a trustworthy network out of untrustworthy parts? | RSAC 2020
video.description:
World-renowned cybersecurity expert, Bruce Schneier, wrestles with the question that results from our global supply chain today. What will it take to build a trustworthy network out of untrustworthy parts? Spoiler alert: more research is needed.

Watch the full keynote here: https://www.rsaconference.com/industry-topics/presentation/how-to-reduce-supply-chain-risk-lessons-from-efforts-to-block-huawei

video.title: Preview: Designing security to be adopted rather than engineered to be enforced | RSAC 2020
video.description:
Wise words from Wendy Nather, Head of Advisory CISOs at Cisco, on engineering security to be adopted vs. enforced.

Watch the full keynote here: https://www.rsaconference.com/industry-topics/presentation/we-the-people-democratizing-security
